plain_description.what: Mistral-induced rubrics were compared with rubrics written by a frontier model and with 'contrastive' rubrics built with wrong answers in view. The Mistral judge used each one, over about 6,000 jobs.
plain_description.why: It tests whether better-written grading rubrics make the judge more accurate.
plain_description.information: A gain would make rubric authorship worth investing in. No gain would close that line. Result: done. No gain. Contrastive rubrics were slightly worse (-1.8 points, p = 0.043), and frontier-written ones were not significantly different. Rubric text is not the lever. The run had no pool check at run time; one was added afterwards. Later ruled history rather than evidence, because it ran on the older question pool.
